title.zh: 卷516 列傳三百三 土司傳五 广西
title.en: Volume 516 Biographies 303: Native Chieftain Biographies 5: Guangxi
title.raw: 卷516 列傳三百三 土司傳五 广西

sentences.zh: 廣西為西南邊地。

translations.literal: Guangxi is a southwestern frontier region.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi formed the empire's southwestern frontier.

sentences.zh: 秦，桂林郡。

translations.literal: Under Qin, it was Guilin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: The Qin organized it as Guilin Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢，始安。

translations.literal: Under Han, it was Shian.
translations.idiomatic: The Han called the area Shian.

sentences.zh: 唐，桂管。

translations.literal: Under Tang, it was Guiguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang placed it under the Guiguan circuit.

sentences.zh: 宋，靜江府。

translations.literal: Under Song, it was Jingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Song renamed it Jingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元，靜江路。

translations.literal: Under Yuan, it was Jingjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan administered it as Jingjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明建廣西省。

translations.literal: Ming established Guangxi Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming created Guangxi as a province.

sentences.zh: 瑤、僮多於漢人十倍，盤萬山之中，踞三江之險。

translations.literal: Yao and Zhuang outnumbered Han Chinese tenfold, coiled among myriad mountains, holding the peril of the three rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Yao and Zhuang peoples outnumbered Han settlers ten to one, spread through endless mountain ranges and holding the strategic heights where three rivers met.

sentences.zh: 明時，因元之舊，多設土司，以資鎮壓。

translations.literal: In Ming times, following Yuan precedent, many native chieftains were installed to provide suppression.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming, continuing Yuan practice, appointed numerous native chieftains to help keep the region under control.

sentences.zh: 叛服不常，韓雍之定藤峽，王守仁之撫田州，沈希儀、俞大猷之戰功，殷正茂、翁萬達之成績，僅得勘定。

translations.literal: Rebellion and submission were inconstant; Han Yong's pacification of Teng Gorge, Wang Shouren's soothing of Tianzhou, Shen Xiyi and Yu Dayou's battle achievements, Yin Zhengmao and Weng Wanda's accomplishments only managed to survey and settle.
translations.idiomatic: Loyalty and revolt shifted unpredictably. Han Yong's suppression of Teng Gorge, Wang Shouren's pacification of Tianzhou, the campaigns of Shen Xiyi and Yu Dayou, and the successes of Yin Zhengmao and Weng Wanda barely sufficed to restore order.

sentences.zh: 清朝，廣西莠民四起，土司獨安靖無事。

translations.literal: In the Qing dynasty, Guangxi's wicked people rose on all sides, while native chieftains alone remained tranquil without incident.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Qing, troublemakers stirred throughout Guangxi, yet the native chieftain domains alone stayed quiet.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾泰經略三省，革泗城土府岑映宸職，割江北地隸貴州。

translations.literal: Ortai administered the three provinces, abolished Sicheng native prefect Cen Yingchen's office, and carved out lands north of the river to attach to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Ortai took charge of the three southwestern provinces, he stripped Cen Yingchen of the Sicheng native prefecture and transferred the territory north of the river to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年八月，首討思陵州之八達寨，扼其餉道，屯兵二三里外，量大砲所能及，漸轟進偪。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year of Yongzheng, he first attacked Bada Stockade in Siling Prefecture, seized its supply routes, encamped troops two or three li outside, measured the range of great cannon, and gradually bombarded forward in approach.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yongzheng 6, he opened operations against Bada Stockade in Siling Prefecture, cutting its supply lines and stationing troops two or three li away. Judging the range of his heavy guns, he shelled the position step by step until his forces closed in.

sentences.zh: 賊窘急，斬土目顏光色兄弟以獻，尚閉寨不出，遂為官兵所毀。

translations.literal: The bandits, pressed hard, beheaded native officer Yan Guangse and his brothers to offer in surrender, yet still closed the stockade and would not come out, and so it was destroyed by government troops.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered, the rebels executed the native officers Yan Guangse and his brothers and sent their heads as a plea for mercy, but still refused to open the stockade. Government forces then stormed and destroyed it.

sentences.zh: 八年，復檄討思明土府所屬之鄧橫寨，三路進攻，一鼓而克。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, he again issued orders to attack Dengheng Stockade under Siming native prefecture; three columns advanced, and it was taken in a single assault.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8 he ordered a second campaign against Dengheng Stockade, a dependency of Siming native prefecture. Three columns attacked at once and carried the place in one rush.

sentences.zh: 於是遠近土目爭繳軍器二萬餘。

translations.literal: Thereupon native officers near and far competed to surrender more than twenty thousand weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Native officers throughout the region then hurried to turn in more than twenty thousand weapons.

sentences.zh: 巡邊所至，迎扈千里，三省邊防皆定。

translations.literal: Wherever he toured the frontier, escorts welcomed him for a thousand li, and the border defenses of all three provinces were settled.
translations.idiomatic: On his frontier tours, local leaders escorted him for hundreds of miles, and the border defenses of all three provinces were secured.

sentences.zh: 秦，象郡。

translations.literal: Under Qin, it was Xiang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Qin times the area belonged to Xiang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 漢，交阯、日南二郡界。

translations.literal: Under Han, it lay on the border of Jiaozhi and Rinan, two commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: The Han placed it on the boundary between Jiaozhi and Rinan commanderies.

sentences.zh: 唐置粵州，天寶初，改龍水郡；

translations.literal: Tang established Yue Prefecture; at the beginning of Tianbao, it was changed to Longshui Commandery;
translations.idiomatic: The Tang set up Yue Prefecture, which at the start of the Tianbao era was renamed Longshui Commandery;

sentences.zh: 乾元中，更宜州。

translations.literal: in the Qianyuan period, it was again changed to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: and in the Qianyuan period it became Yizhou again.

sentences.zh: 宋升慶遠軍節度，咸淳初，改慶遠府。

translations.literal: Song raised it to Qingyuan military commission; at the beginning of Xianchun, it was changed to Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Song elevated it to the Qingyuan military commission, and at the opening of the Xianchun era renamed it Qingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元為慶遠路。

translations.literal: Yuan made it Qingyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan administered it as Qingyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明仍改慶遠府。

translations.literal: Ming again changed it to Qingyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming restored the name Qingyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清因之。

translations.literal: Qing followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 東蘭土州，在府西南。

translations.literal: Donglan native prefecture lay southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Donglan Native Prefecture stood southwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋置蘭州，以韋氏世襲。

translations.literal: Song established Lan Prefecture, with the Wei clan holding hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created Lan Prefecture and granted hereditary rule to the Wei clan.

sentences.zh: 元改東蘭州。

translations.literal: Yuan changed it to Donglan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan renamed it Donglan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明因之。

translations.literal: Ming followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming retained the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 傳至韋光祚，清順治初，歸附，予舊職，雍正七年，改設流官知州。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wei Guangzuo; at the beginning of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, was given his former office, and in the seventh year of Yongzheng regular officials were installed as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Wei Guangzuo, who submitted early in Shunzhi and kept his old post until Yongzheng 7, when the court replaced the native prefect with a regular appointee.

sentences.zh: 忻城土縣，在府南。

translations.literal: Xincheng native county lay south of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng Native County lay south of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋慶曆間，隸宜州。

translations.literal: During the Qingli era of Song, it was subordinate to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song, during the Qingli period, it fell under Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 元以莫保為八仙屯千戶。

translations.literal: Yuan appointed Mo Bao as chiliarch of Baxian Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan made Mo Bao chiliarch of Baxian Stockade.

sentences.zh: 明洪武初，設流官。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu in Ming, regular officials were installed.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu the Ming posted regular officials there.

sentences.zh: 後仍任土官，以莫氏世襲。

translations.literal: Later native officials were again appointed, with the Mo clan holding hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Later the court again entrusted the post to a native magistrate, with the Mo clan succeeding hereditarily.

sentences.zh: 傳至莫猛，清順治九年，歸附，仍准襲職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Mo Meng; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted to inherit the office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Mo Meng, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and was allowed to keep the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 南丹土州，在府西北。

translations.literal: Nandan native prefecture lay northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Nandan Native Prefecture lay northwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋開寶初，土官莫洪內附；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaibao in Song, native officer Mo Hong submitted within;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaibao era the native officer Mo Hong submitted to the Song;

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，置州，管轄諸蠻。

translations.literal: in the third year of Yuanfeng, a prefecture was established to govern the various barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: and in the third year of Yuanfeng the court created a prefecture to govern the surrounding tribes.

sentences.zh: 明洪武初，莫金納土。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu in Ming, Mo Jin presented the land.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu, Mo Jin surrendered the territory.

sentences.zh: 金叛被誅，以金子祿襲。

translations.literal: Jin rebelled and was executed; his son Lu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin rebelled he was executed, and his son Lu inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 傳至莫自乾，清順治九年，歸附，仍准襲職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Mo Ziqian; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted to inherit the office.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Mo Ziqian, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and was confirmed in the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 那地土州，在府西。

translations.literal: Nadi native prefecture lay west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Nadi Native Prefecture lay west of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋熙甯初，土人羅世念來降；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining in Song, the native man Luo Shinian came to surrender;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xining era the local leader Luo Shinian submitted;

sentences.zh: 崇寧間，遂置地、那二州，以羅氏世知地州。

translations.literal: during Chongning, Di and Na, two prefectures, were then established, with the Luo clan hereditarily serving as prefects of Di Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: and during Chongning the court set up Di and Na prefectures, with the Luo clan holding hereditary rule over Di.

sentences.zh: 元仍之。

translations.literal: Yuan continued this.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan kept the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 明洪武元年，土官羅黃貌附，詔並那、地為一州，予印授，黃貌世襲，以流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu in Ming, native officer Luo Huangmao submitted; an edict merged Na and Di into one prefecture, granted a seal and appointment, with Huangmao holding hereditary succession, assisted by a regular official clerk.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 the native officer Luo Huangmao submitted. The court merged Na and Di into a single prefecture, issued a seal, and granted Huangmao hereditary rule, assisted by a regular clerk.

sentences.zh: 傳至羅德壽，清順治九年，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Luo Deshou; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Luo Deshou, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and retained the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 永順正土司，在府西南。

translations.literal: The principal Yongshun native chieftain lay southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The principal Yongshun native chieftaincy lay southwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明設土司，弘治間，以鄧文茂為之。

translations.literal: Ming established a native chieftain; during Hongzhi, Deng Wenmao was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming created the post during the Hongzhi reign and appointed Deng Wenmao.

sentences.zh: 傳至鄧世廣，清順治九年，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Deng Shiguang; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Deng Shiguang, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 副土司。

translations.literal: Deputy native chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy native chieftain:

sentences.zh: 彭希聖，同。

translations.literal: Peng Xisheng, the same.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Xisheng, with the same arrangement.

sentences.zh: 永定土司，在府西南。

translations.literal: Yongding native chieftain lay southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongding native chieftaincy lay southwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明成化十二年，設土司，以韋萬秀為之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Chenghua in Ming, a native chieftain was established, with Wei Wanxiu appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 12 the Ming created the post and appointed Wei Wanxiu.

sentences.zh: 傳至韋盛春，清順治九年，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wei Shengchun; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Wei Shengchun, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 古百粵。

translations.literal: Ancient Baiyue.
translations.idiomatic: The region had been ancient Baiyue country.

sentences.zh: 漢屬交阯。

translations.literal: Han belonged to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it fell within Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 唐天寶元年，改為橫山郡。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianbao in Tang, it was changed to Hengshan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianbao 1 the Tang renamed it Hengshan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元置田州路軍民總管府。

translations.literal: Yuan established Tianzhou Circuit Military-Civilian Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan set up the Tianzhou Circuit Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明正統五年，升為思恩府。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhengtong in Ming, it was raised to Si'en Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 5 the Ming elevated the territory to Si'en Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 弘治末，改流官，清因之。

translations.literal: At the end of Hongzhi, regular officials were installed; Qing followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Late in Hongzhi the court replaced the native administration with regular officials, and the Qing kept that system.

sentences.zh: 上林土縣，在府西南二百七里。

translations.literal: Shanglin native county lay two hundred seven li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Shanglin Native County stood two hundred seven li southwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋置，隸橫山寨。

translations.literal: Song established it, subordinate to Hengshan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created the county under Hengshan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬田州。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二年，以黃嵩為土知縣，仍屬田州；

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu in Ming, Huang Song was made native magistrate, still subordinate to Tianzhou;
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 the Ming appointed Huang Song native magistrate, leaving the county under Tianzhou;

sentences.zh: 嘉靖初，改隸思恩軍民府，佐以流官典史。

translations.literal: at the beginning of Jiajing, it was changed to be subordinate to Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture, assisted by a regular official registrar.
translations.idiomatic: and early in Jiajing transferred it to Si'en Military-Civilian Prefecture with a regular registrar as assistant.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃國安，清初，歸附，仍襲舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Guo'an; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and still inherited the former office.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Huang Guo'an, who submitted at the founding of the Qing and kept his hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 白山土司，在府東北。

translations.literal: Baishan native chieftain lay northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Baishan native chieftaincy lay northeast of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 宋皇祐間，隨狄青有功，世襲土舍。

translations.literal: During Huangyou in Song, following Di Qing with merit, hereditary native headman was granted.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangyou a clan that served under Di Qing was rewarded with a hereditary native headmanship.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以王受明為白山土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Wang Shouming was made Baishan native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Wang Shouming Baishan native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至王如綸，清初，歸附，仍襲舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wang Rulun; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and still inherited the former office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Wang Rulun, who submitted at the Qing founding and retained the post.

sentences.zh: 興隆土司，在府東北八十里。

translations.literal: Xinglong native chieftain lay eighty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Xinglong native chieftaincy lay eighty li northeast of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以韋貴為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Wei Gui was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Wei Gui native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至韋萬安，清順治十七年，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wei Wan'an; in the seventeenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Wei Wan'an, who submitted in Shunzhi 17 and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 那馬土司，在府西北九十里。

translations.literal: Nama native chieftain lay ninety li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Nama native chieftaincy lay ninety li northwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以黃理為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Huang Li was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Huang Li native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃天倫，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Tianlun; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Huang Tianlun, who submitted at the Qing founding and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 定羅土司，在府西一百四十里。

translations.literal: Dingluo native chieftain lay one hundred forty li west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Dingluo native chieftaincy lay one hundred forty li west of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以徐伍為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Xu Wu was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Xu Wu native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至徐朝佐，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Xu Chaozuo; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Xu Chaozuo, who submitted at the Qing founding and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 舊城土司，在府西北一百二十里。

translations.literal: Jiucheng native chieftain lay one hundred twenty li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiucheng native chieftaincy lay one hundred twenty li northwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以黃集為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Huang Ji was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Huang Ji native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃世勳，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Shixun; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Huang Shixun, who submitted at the Qing founding and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 下旺土司，在府西二百十里。

translations.literal: Xiawang native chieftain lay two hundred ten li west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiawang native chieftaincy lay two hundred ten li west of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以韋良保為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Wei Liangbao was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Wei Liangbao native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至韋際弦，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wei Jixian; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Wei Jixian, who submitted at the Qing founding and kept the hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 安定土司，在府北。

translations.literal: Anding native chieftain lay north of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Anding native chieftaincy lay north of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以潘良為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Pan Liang was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Pan Liang native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至潘應璧，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Pan Yingbi; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Pan Yingbi, who submitted at the Qing founding and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 都陽土司，在府西北六百里。

translations.literal: Duyang native chieftain lay six hundred li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Duyang native chieftaincy lay six hundred li northwest of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以黃留為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Huang Liu was made native inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 7 the Ming appointed Huang Liu native inspector.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃宏會，清初，歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Honghui; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Huang Honghui, who submitted at the Qing founding and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 古零土司，在府東。

translations.literal: Guling native chieftain lay east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Guling native chieftaincy lay east of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖七年，以覃益為土巡檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing in Ming, Qin Yi was made native inspector.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二十二年，以趙世賢為知州，給印。

translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Zhao Yinchang, who was murdered by his kinsman Jizu.

sentences.zh: 清順治十六年，歸附，誅繼祖。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, submission was accepted, and Jizu was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 16 the court accepted submission and executed Jizu.

sentences.zh: 廕昌無子，以邦顯子廷耀襲。

translations.literal: Yinchang had no son; Bangxian's son Tingyao succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: As Yinchang had no heir, Bangxian's son Tingyao inherited the post.

sentences.zh: 佶倫州，在府東北，舊名邦兜。

sentences.zh: 元改州，屬太平路。

sentences.zh: 傳至馮嘉猷，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

sentences.zh: 都結州，在府東北。

translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3 the Ming appointed Nong Wugao prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至農廷封，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Nong Tingfeng; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Nong Tingfeng, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 上下凍州，在府西。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Dong Prefectures lay west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and Lower Dong Prefectures lay west of Taiping fu.

sentences.zh: 宋置凍州。

translations.literal: Song established Dong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created Dong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元分凍州為上凍、下凍二州。

translations.literal: Yuan divided Dong Prefecture into Upper Dong and Lower Dong, two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan split Dong into Upper Dong and Lower Dong prefectures.

sentences.zh: 明隸太平府，洪武元年，以趙帖從為知州。

translations.literal: Ming was subordinate to Taiping Prefecture; in the first year of Hongwu, Zhao Tiecong was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it belonged to Taiping Prefecture; in Hongwu 1 Zhao Tiecong was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至趙長亨，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zhao Changheng; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Zhao Changheng, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and kept hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 恩城州，在府西北。

translations.literal: Encheng Prefecture lay northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Encheng Prefecture lay northwest of Taiping fu.

sentences.zh: 唐置。

translations.literal: Tang established it.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang created it.

sentences.zh: 宋分上下恩城二州。

translations.literal: Song divided it into Upper and Lower Encheng, two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Song divided it into Upper and Lower Encheng.

sentences.zh: 元屬太平路。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 至正間並為一。

translations.literal: During Zhizheng they were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhizheng era the two were reunited.

sentences.zh: 明洪武元年，以趙雄傑為知州。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu in Ming, Zhao Xiongjie was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 the Ming appointed Zhao Xiongjie prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至趙貴炫，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zhao Guixuan; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Zhao Guixuan, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 羅陽土縣，在府東，舊名福利。

translations.idiomatic: Luoyang Native County lay east of Taiping fu; it had formerly been called Fuli.

translations.literal: Song established it, subordinate to Qianlong Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created it under Qianlong Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬太平路。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Taiping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明隸太平府，明初，以黃宣為知縣。

translations.literal: Ming was subordinate to Taiping Prefecture; at the beginning of Ming, Huang Xuan was made magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it belonged to Taiping Prefecture; early in the dynasty Huang Xuan was appointed magistrate.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃啟祥，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Qixiang; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Huang Qixiang, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and kept hereditary succession.

translations.idiomatic: Siling Prefecture.

translations.idiomatic: The Song created the prefecture under Yongping Stockade.

translations.literal: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明初，省入思明府，後復建，仍隸太平府；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, it was streamlined into Siming Prefecture; later rebuilt, still subordinate to Taiping Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming it was absorbed into Siming Prefecture, then restored and again placed under Taiping Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 洪武二十一年，以韋延壽為知州。

translations.literal: in the twenty-first year of Hongwu, Wei Yanshou was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: and in Hongwu 21 Wei Yanshou was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至韋懋選，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wei Maoxuan; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Wei Maoxuan, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 思明州。

translations.literal: Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Siming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 唐置，屬邕州。

translations.literal: Tang established it, belonging to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang created it under Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋隸太平寨。

translations.literal: Under the Song it was subordinate to Taiping Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it fell under Taiping Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元改思明路。

translations.literal: Yuan changed it to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan organized it as Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明為府，洪武元年，以黃忽都為知府。

translations.literal: Ming made it a prefecture; in the first year of Hongwu, Huang Hudu was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming elevated it to a fu; in Hongwu 1 Huang Hudu was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃戴乾，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Daiqian; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still given his former office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Huang Daiqian, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and kept his former post.

sentences.zh: 黃觀珠襲。

translations.literal: Huang Guanzhu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Guanzhu inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 以安馬、洞郎等五十村改流，隸南寧。

translations.literal: Fifty villages including Anma and Donglang were changed to regular administration and attached to Nanning.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty villages including Anma and Donglang were placed under regular officials and transferred to Nanning.

sentences.zh: 明降府為州，移治伯江哨。

translations.literal: Ming reduced the prefecture to a prefecture-level district and moved the seat to Bojiang Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming downgraded the fu to a zhou and moved the seat to Bojiang Stockade.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，五十村目怨觀珠，殺觀珠嬖人，欲因以謀不靖。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng, the fifty village heads resented Guanzhu, killed Guanzhu's favorite, and wished thereby to plot unrest.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 the heads of the fifty villages, angry at Guanzhu, killed his favorite and tried to use the incident to stir rebellion.

sentences.zh: 太平知府屠嘉正、新太協副將崔善元安定之。

translations.literal: Taiping Prefect Tu Jiazheng and Xintai Assistant Regional Commander Cui Shanyuan pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Prefect Tu Jiazheng and Assistant Regional Commander Cui Shanyuan of Xintai pacified the disturbance.

sentences.zh: 觀珠以罪參革，改流。

translations.literal: Guanzhu was impeached and removed for crime, and administration was changed to regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhu was impeached and dismissed, and native rule was replaced with regular officials.

sentences.zh: 又思明州與思明府本兩地，土官亦黃姓，於康熙五十八年改流。

translations.literal: Moreover Siming Prefecture and Siming fu were originally two places; the native officers were also of the Huang surname, and in the fifty-eighth year of Kangxi were changed to regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: Siming Prefecture and Siming fu had originally been separate territories, both ruled by Huang clansmen; both were converted to regular administration in Kangxi 58.

sentences.zh: 下石西州，在府西二百十里。

translations.literal: Lower Shixi Prefecture lay two hundred ten li west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Lower Shixi Prefecture lay two hundred ten li west of the fu seat.

sentences.zh: 宋閉鴻為知州。

translations.literal: In Song, Bi Hong was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song Bi Hong served as prefect.

sentences.zh: 明初，仍給世襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, hereditary succession was still granted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming the court again granted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 傳至閉承恩，清初，歸附，仍襲舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Bi Chengen; at the beginning of Qing, he submitted, and still inherited the former office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Bi Chengen, who submitted at the Qing founding and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 上石西州。

translations.literal: Upper Shixi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Shixi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明崇禎間，併入本府。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen in Ming, it was merged into this prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongzhen it was merged into the parent prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清雍正十二年，改隸明江同知。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng in Qing, it was changed to be subordinate to Mingjiang sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 it was placed under the Mingjiang sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 上龍司。

translations.literal: Shanglong Department.
translations.idiomatic: Shanglong Department.

sentences.zh: 漢屬交阯。

translations.literal: Han belonged to Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Han it fell within Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 唐置龍州。

translations.literal: Tang established Long Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang set up Long Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋隸邕州。

translations.literal: Song was subordinate to Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it belonged to Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元大德中，改為萬戶府。

translations.literal: During Dade in Yuan, it was changed to a myriarchate.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dade era the Yuan made it a myriarchate.

sentences.zh: 明初，屬太平。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, it belonged to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming it belonged to Taiping.

sentences.zh: 洪武八年，改直隸州，尋改隸太平。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Hongwu, it was changed to a directly administered prefecture, then soon changed to be subordinate to Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 8 it became a directly administered prefecture, then was soon placed back under Taiping.

sentences.zh: 以土官趙帖堅襲知州，以流官吏目佐之。

translations.literal: Native officer Zhao Tiejian inherited as prefect, assisted by a regular official clerk.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tiejian inherited as native prefect, assisted by a regular clerk.

sentences.zh: 其後事具明史。

translations.literal: Later affairs are fully recorded in the History of Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Later events are recorded in full in the History of Ming.

sentences.zh: 傳至趙有涇，為庶兄有濤所殺。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zhao Youjing, who was killed by his elder half-brother Youtao.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Zhao Youjing, murdered by his elder half-brother Youtao.

sentences.zh: 有涇子國梁愬父冤，有濤逃入交阯。

translations.literal: Youjing's son Guoliang appealed his father's wrong; Youtao fled into Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: Youjing's son Guoliang petitioned to avenge his father, while Youtao fled to Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 清平廣西，更名趙祿奇，自交阯逃回歸附，仍予舊職。

translations.literal: When Qing pacified Guangxi, he changed his name to Zhao Luqi, fled back from Jiaozhi to submit, and was still given his former office.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qing pacified Guangxi, Youtao renamed himself Zhao Luqi, returned from Jiaozhi to submit, and was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 死，傳子廷楠。

translations.literal: He died; his son Tingnan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, his son Tingnan inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 時國梁父冤既白，應襲，而廷楠拒之；

translations.literal: At that time Guoliang's father's wrong had been cleared and he ought to succeed, but Tingnan refused;
translations.idiomatic: By then Guoliang's claim had been vindicated and he should have inherited, but Tingnan refused;

sentences.zh: 國梁復出奔，適雲南煽動，遂率賊兵破州城，殺廷楠。

translations.literal: Guoliang fled again; just as Yunnan was being stirred up, he then led bandit troops to break the prefectural city and kill Tingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Guoliang fled once more, and when unrest spread from Yunnan he led rebel forces against the prefectural seat and killed Tingnan.

sentences.zh: 未幾撲滅。

translations.literal: Before long it was suppressed and extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: The revolt was soon crushed.

sentences.zh: 而廷楠無子，乃以庶支趙元基孫國桓襲。

translations.literal: But Tingnan had no son, so a collateral line, Zhao Yuanji's grandson Guohuan, succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: As Tingnan left no heir, the post passed to Guohuan, grandson of a collateral descendant Zhao Yuanji.

sentences.zh: 傳子殿灴，雍正三年，以貪殘參革，析其地為上龍司、下龍司；

translations.literal: His son Dianhuo succeeded; in the third year of Yongzheng, for greed and cruelty he was impeached and removed, and his territory was divided into Shanglong Department and Xialong Department;
translations.idiomatic: His son Dianhuo inherited, but in Yongzheng 3 was impeached for corruption and cruelty. The territory was split into Shanglong and Xialong departments;

sentences.zh: 改設兩巡檢，平通判兼攝。

translations.literal: two native inspectors were installed, with the Ping sub-prefect holding concurrent charge.
translations.idiomatic: each with a native inspector, both overseen concurrently by the Ping sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 後改龍州廳。

translations.literal: Later it was changed to Longzhou Department.
translations.idiomatic: It was later reorganized as Longzhou Department.

sentences.zh: 憑祥州。

translations.literal: Pingxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Pingxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋為憑祥峒，屬永平寨。

translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was Pingxiang dong under Yongping Stockade.

translations.literal: Yuan was subordinate to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明洪武初，李升內附，置憑祥鎮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Hongwu in Ming, Li Sheng submitted and came over, and Pingxiang Garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Hongwu Li Sheng submitted and the court set up Pingxiang Garrison.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，置縣；

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, a county was established;
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 2 it became a county;

sentences.zh: 成化八年，升州，以升孫李廣寧為知州。

translations.literal: in the eighth year of Chenghua, it was raised to a prefecture, with Sheng's grandson Li Guangning made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: and in Chenghua 8 was elevated to a prefecture, with Sheng's grandson Li Guangning as prefect.

sentences.zh: 時又屬安南，仍歸明，屬太平府。

translations.literal: At the time it again belonged to Annam, yet still returned to Ming, subordinate to Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time it again belonged to Annam, yet it returned to Ming control and was placed under Taiping Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至李維籓，清順治十六年，歸附，仍予世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Li Weifan; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Li Weifan, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and retained hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 江州。

translations.literal: Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋置，屬古萬寨。

translations.literal: Song established it, belonging to Guwan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created it under Guwan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元隸思明路。

translations.literal: Yuan was subordinate to Siming Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Siming Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明因之，洪武初，以黃威慶為知州。

translations.literal: Ming followed this; at the beginning of Hongwu, Huang Weiqing was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming kept the arrangement; early in Hongwu Huang Weiqing was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至黃廷傑，清順治十六年，歸附，仍襲舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Tingjie; in the sixteenth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and still inherited the former office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Huang Tingjie, who submitted in Shunzhi 16 and kept the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 在省西。

translations.literal: It lay west of the province.
translations.idiomatic: It lay west of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 宋時於鎮安峒建右江軍民宣撫司。

translations.literal: In Song times the Youjiang Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was built at Zhen'an dong.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song a Youjiang Military-Civilian Pacification Commission was established at Zhen'an dong.

sentences.zh: 元改鎮安路。

translations.literal: Yuan changed it to Zhen'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan reorganized it as Zhen'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明洪武元年，改府，授土官岑天保為知府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu in Ming, it was changed to a prefecture, and native officer Cen Tianbao was granted as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 1 the Ming made it a fu and appointed the native officer Cen Tianbao prefect.

sentences.zh: 清順治間，土官故絕，沈文崇叛據其地；

translations.literal: During Shunzhi in Qing, the native officer line died out, and Shen Wenchong rebelled and seized the territory;
translations.idiomatic: During Shunzhi the native line died out and Shen Wenchong rebelled and seized the territory;

sentences.zh: 十八年，發兵撲滅之。

translations.literal: in the eighteenth year, troops were dispatched to suppress and extinguish it.
translations.idiomatic: and in Shunzhi 18 government forces crushed the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 康熙二年，改置流官通判。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi, a regular official sub-prefect was installed.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 the court appointed a regular sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，改知府。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng, it was changed to a regular prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 it was changed to a regular prefect.

sentences.zh: 都康州。

translations.literal: Dukang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dukang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋置，隸橫山寨。

translations.literal: Song established it, subordinate to Hengshan Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created it under Hengshan Stockade.

sentences.zh: 元屬田州路。

translations.literal: Yuan belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it belonged to Tianzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 明洪武三十二年，復置州。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Hongwu in Ming, the prefecture was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 32 the Ming restored the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂初，以馮斌為知州，隸思恩府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yongle, Feng Bin was made prefect, subordinate to Si'en Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yongle the Ming appointed Feng Bin prefect and placed the territory under Si'en Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 傳至馮太一，清順治九年，歸附，襲舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Feng Taiyi; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted and inherited the former office.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Feng Taiyi, who submitted in Shunzhi 9 and inherited the hereditary post.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，鎮安設府，改隸鎮安。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, Zhen'an was established as a prefecture, and it was changed to be subordinate to Zhen'an.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7 Zhen'an was elevated to a fu, and Dukang was transferred to its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 上映峒。

translations.literal: Shangying dong.
translations.idiomatic: Shangying dong.

sentences.zh: 宋置州。

translations.literal: Song established a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Song created a prefecture there.

sentences.zh: 明初，廢為峒，以許尚爵襲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, it was abolished and made a dong, with Xu Shangjue holding hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming it was reduced to a dong, with Xu Shangjue succeeding hereditarily.

sentences.zh: 傳至許國泰，清順治初，歸附，仍予舊職。

translations.literal: The line passed to Xu Guotai; at the beginning of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, and was still given his former office.
translations.idiomatic: The line reached Xu Guotai, who submitted early in Shunzhi and kept his former post.

sentences.zh: 湖潤寨。

translations.literal: Hurun Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Hurun Stockade.

sentences.zh: 宋時置州。

translations.literal: In Song times a prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Song established a prefecture there.

sentences.zh: 明初，廢州為寨，降巡檢司。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming, the prefecture was abolished into a stockade, demoted to a native inspector's office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Ming the prefecture was abolished and reduced to a stockade with a native inspector's office.

sentences.zh: 傳至宗熙，清順治九年，歸附，仍給巡檢司印，世襲。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zong Xi; in the ninth year of Shunzhi in Qing, he submitted, was still granted the native inspector's seal, and held hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: The succession reached Zong Xi, who submitted in Shunzhi 9, received the inspector's seal again, and kept the hereditary office.
